audit_coverage.defect_1_canonical_event_envelopes: All bases are literal Event histories and every materialized mutation is rehashed into a valid contiguous chain before domain validation.
audit_coverage.defect_2_product_feasible_terminal_shape: The timeout and invalid bases bind current product terminal status/reason/retryability/error shapes.
audit_coverage.defect_3_history_mutation_rehash_and_ide: Mutation semantics rehash envelopes; public same-body idempotency is a positive control, while duplicate replay uses two unique event IDs in one valid chain.
audit_coverage.defect_4_multi_axis_precedence: Ten multi-axis rows cover every adjacent transition in structural > contract > digest > ID > generation > seal > compatibility > experiment/Proposal > terminal > observation/artifact > duplicate.
audit_coverage.defect_5_result_artifact_fail_closed: Decision exact shape/authority (3) plus status/reason/primary-metric binding to the terminal payload (3), observation exact binding (10 total, including the 7 appended axes), and every ArtifactEvidenceRef field independently (4) are explicit. Every captured ArtifactRef field, cardinality/digest, and raw ARTIFACT_RECORDED exact keys, null role/authority, exact retention/sensitivity metadata, canonical identity, and project/experiment ownership are independently attacked; all 115 rejects require the same code/path and zero deltas on all 4 execution paths (460 matches).
audit_coverage.defect_6_exact_schema_order_utf8: Wrapper/body/nested missing-extra, duplicate artifact refs, artifact-after-terminal, two-gate noncanonical/duplicate IDs, exact 16,384/16,385 UTF-8 boundaries, trimmed nonblank narrative text, lone-surrogate pre-hash rejection, and strict bool-versus-int boundaries are immutable cases.

mutation_policy.mutation_root: the selected diagnosis_event.payload unless an event_selector or history operation is declared
mutation_policy.application_order: Apply input.mutations left-to-right to a deep copy of terminal_record canonical_history plus diagnosis_event.
derived_recompute_order: canonical ArtifactRecord identity when explicitly requested
Diagnosis Event and any tail Event envelopes
mutation_policy.event_rehash: After domain mutations, retain event IDs unless new_event_id is declared, renumber the ordered list from 1, set prev_hash to the preceding recomputed hash, and recompute hash as sha256(canonical_bytes(unsigned_event_envelope)). occurred_at remains unchanged; timestamp monotonicity is not an Event invariant.
mutation_policy.evidence_rebind: Only fields named by input.recompute are rebound. Deliberate evidence mismatch attacks retain the attacked value while all Event envelopes are still rehashed.
mutation_policy.pre_diagnosis_dependency_rule: Rehash all events before a Diagnosis first; then bind their new hashes when requested, recompute Diagnosis digest/ID, and hash the Diagnosis. A terminal deliberately moved after Diagnosis is not rebound because the validator must reject its absence at the Diagnosis sequence.
mutation_policy.postcondition: Event.from_mapping accepts every materialized envelope and verify_events accepts the complete mutated chain before any declared Diagnosis error is asserted.
mutation_policy.public_idempotency: Submitting an identical body through the Diagnosis service returns the existing event and appends zero events.
mutation_policy.corrupted_replay: A second persisted Diagnosis uses a unique event_id and a recomputed valid chain; replay rejects DIAGNOSIS_ALREADY_RECORDED even when payloads are identical.
mutation_policy.artifact_event_selector: artifact_event_index selects the Nth ARTIFACT_RECORDED event in current history order and its path is relative to that event payload.
mutation_policy.artifact_record_identity_recompute: artifact_record_identity reparses all immutable record fields and recomputes artifact_id = stable_id(artifact, project_id, experiment_id, relative_path, digest, role, media_type, metadata); it never repairs malformed storage_path or unknown/authority fields.
mutation_policy.registered_decoy_reassignment: reassign_artifact_to_registered_decoy injects deep copies of the named source record BASELINE_RECORDED and EXPERIMENT_REGISTERED envelopes immediately before the first artifact, changes only the selected ArtifactRecord experiment_id to that now-registered experiment, recomputes artifact_id, then follows the common rehash/evidence rules.
mutation_policy.terminal_nested_mutations: Mutating terminal Decision, ResultEnvelope, or captured ArtifactRef rehashes the terminal and rebinds only terminal_evidence when listed; the attacked terminal value is never normalized or repaired.
mutation_policy.artifact_event_raw_exactness: ARTIFACT_RECORDED payload must have exactly ArtifactRecord fields artifact_id,project_id,experiment_id,digest,algorithm,size,relative_path,storage_path,role,media_type,metadata,captured_at plus authorized_action; role and authorized_action must be literal null; metadata must be exactly {retention,sensitivity}. ArtifactRecord.from_mapping normalization is not acceptance authority.
mutation_policy.prehash_surrogate_validation: Raw JSON submission recipes carrying an escaped lone U+D800 code unit must fail Diagnosis structural validation before UTF-8 encoding, canonical hashing, diagnosis ID derivation, Event construction, or append is attempted.
mutation_policy.structural_type_precedence: Whitespace-only or non-trimmed narrative text and bool-versus-int/literal-boolean substitutions fail with DIAGNOSIS_INVALID before stale diagnosis digest or ID checks; therefore those encodable attacks rehash Event envelopes but deliberately do not recompute Diagnosis identity.
